summary: Dashboard Template Edit Feature - All tests passed. Backend PUT endpoint correctly updates template name/description with proper auth checks. Frontend edit UI works perfectly: edit button appears on hover, edit mode shows input fields for name/description, Save updates the template via API and shows success toast, Cancel discards changes properly.

working_endpoints: PUT endpoint returns 404 for non-existent templates
PUT endpoint returns 404 for preset templates (not owned by user)

working_features: Edit button (pencil icon) appears on custom template cards on hover
Delete button (trash icon) appears alongside edit button on hover
Clicking edit button switches template card to inline edit mode
Edit mode shows input field for template name (autofocused)
Edit mode shows textarea for template description
Cancel button exits edit mode without saving changes
Save button calls PUT endpoint and updates template successfully
Success toast 'Template updated' appears after save
Template name and description update in UI immediately after save
Card border highlights in violet when in edit mode

passed_tests: ✅ Backend: PUT /api/dashboard-templates/{id} updates name and description
✅ Backend: PUT returns 404 for non-existent template
✅ Backend: PUT returns 404 for preset template (not user-owned)
✅ Backend: Partial updates work (only name or only description)
✅ Backend: updated_at timestamp is set on update
✅ Frontend: Edit button visible on hover over custom template card
✅ Frontend: Edit mode activates on edit button click
✅ Frontend: Name input field editable in edit mode
✅ Frontend: Description textarea editable in edit mode
✅ Frontend: Cancel button discards unsaved changes
✅ Frontend: Save button triggers PUT API call
✅ Frontend: Template updated toast appears on save
✅ Frontend: UI reflects updated name/description after save
critical_code_review_comments: Edit feature implementation is clean and follows React best practices
Proper data-testid attributes for all interactive edit elements
Edit state properly isolated per-template using editingId
API error handling with toast notifications in place

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 passed, 1 skipped due to dashboard creation dependency)
